# optimizelycmp_field (Resource)

An organisation-level custom field (used on tasks, campaigns and workflows). The API has no delete: destroying this resource **deactivates** the field and removes it from state. The API marks these endpoints as experimental.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "optimizelycmp_field" "priority" {
  name        = "Priority"
  type        = "dropdown"
  helper_text = "How urgent is this?"

  # The keys (low, high) are for Terraform only: they let you rename a choice without recreating it.
  choices = {
    low  = { name = "Low" }
    high = { name = "High" }
  }
}

resource "optimizelycmp_field" "budget" {
  name                   = "Budget"
  type                   = "currency_number"
  currency_code          = "EUR"
  decimal_places         = 2
  has_thousand_separator = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Field name.
- `type` (String) Field type. It cannot be changed: changing it replaces the field (the old one is left behind, deactivated).

### Optional

- `choices` (Attributes Map) Choices of a dropdown, label, checkbox or radio_button field, keyed by a name of your choosing that Terraform uses to track each one (so renaming a choice does not recreate it). Choices are required for those types and not allowed for others. Choices added in CMP outside Terraform are ignored. The API refuses to delete the last active choice. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--choices))
- `currency_code` (String) currency_number type only. A valid currency code; the API defaults it to USD.
- `decimal_places` (Number) Number types only. Must be greater than 0; the API defaults it to 2.
- `has_thousand_separator` (Boolean) Number types only.
- `helper_text` (String) Text that explains the field to users.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Inactive fields cannot be used in tasks, campaigns or workflows.
- `is_multi_select` (Boolean) Allow several values (dropdown and label types only; defaults to false there).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Field ID.

<a id="nestedatt--choices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `choices`

Required:

- `name` (String) Choice name; must be unique within the field.

Optional:

- `color` (String) label type only: one of #4ECFD5, #FFC700, #FF98A7, #702BD5, #5FEEAD, #D6C4F2, #5F9FF6, #CB5DEB, #9694B3.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Inactive choices stay on the field but users cannot pick them.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Choice ID.
